divisions.headline: Kids and Serious do what they're supposed to do, handling business against lower teams; Angry Birds extend their win streak to four, passing Possee and climbing to #3 spot

picks.text: Angry Birds @ The Kids who say "Ni!" The Kids are on an absolute heater, winning 6 in a row and taking the B lead. But the Birds are on a run too, turning an 0-3 start into a 4-3 grab of 3rd place Supreme matchup here. I'm stick with the Kids, but nervously. 13-11.
picks.call: I'm stick with the Kids, but nervously. 13-11.

picks.text: Consistently Inconsistent @ Only Darts; Bottoms Up @ Liquor Possee. The bottom two in B sit two matches behind the pair of teams ahead of them. If they want to get out of those bottom slots, picking off those directly ahead is key. In the end, both get away though. Inconsistent, 14-10; Possee, 16-8.

divisions.headline: Area just eases by the Ducks to stay undefeated; Menace flexes a little muscle to close the point gap a touch; the Secrets take down the Mafia, now sit just one point behind them

picks.text: Mulligans Mafia @ Area 501. Area hasn't lost in a couple seasons now, so the Mafia has a tall task here. But if they do manage to pull the upset, they could quickly find themselves in 2nd place (and joining Area in B next season). Alas, this is still Area, 14-10.
Still Hump'N @ Pints and Points. Ok, let's not sugarcoat this one… Is this Hump'N's best shot at getting off this season's winless list? Probably. But I think the Pints escape, 14-10.
picks.call: But I think the Pints escape, 14-10.

divisions.headline: What's the Point wins, then takes a little 501 nap; shorthanded Corks grab giant win over Blanks, threaten to re-take the 2nd spot; Mayhem coughs up the league's 4th forfeit

picks.text: Heart of Dartness @ Runs with Corks. It's entirely possible that What's the Point will run away with the E title. But the race for 2nd (and a potential climb to D next season) is a hotly contested one. With the Corks taking out the Blanks last week, the winner here will be alone one match out of 2nd. Corks in the last 501.

divisions.headline: Cheapies bounce back, take all four sets from Nein Mark; Down to F outlasts She Said in a tiebreaker; Shooters grab their 2nd win, pulling Two Time two matches off the lead

picks.text: Death Throw @ That's What She Said. As I've been saying for a month, every last match in F could be critical. DT is on the brink of taking the F lead, but they are simultaneously only two matches from being passed by 5th place She Said. It's only 3 matches from first to last in this mess. Feels like yet another 1001… Death Throw.

Nein Mark @ Two Time. One of these teams might finish in a bottom-two slot and maybe fall to G. Or that same team might finish in a top-two slot and climb to E. And the same is true for the other too. Welcome to F-land (not Efland). Nein Mark, 13-11.
picks.call: Welcome to F-land (not Efland). Nein Mark, 13-11.
